No, I can't tell whether your heart rate stayed elevated all day on October 2, 2026. Your local data has only three heart rate readings for that day.

- **10:00:00:** 100 bpm
- **10:01:00:** 101 bpm
- **10:02:00:** 102 bpm

These readings come from exercise windows only, so they probably reflect a workout around 10 AM. They say nothing about the rest of the day. There are no readings for any other time on October 2, and I can't tell from this data whether your heart rate was high at other times.

To check the whole day, the Google account would need a full-day heart rate import. I can run that for October 2 if you want, though it's a larger download, about 37 MB per day of history. Your Fitbit account has no heart rate data stored locally at all.
